name: Festering Newt — "-4/-4 instead if you control a creature named Bogbrew Witch" looks at your board, not the target's controller's
notes: Memory: project_audit_target_changes_nothing_2026-10-11. The trailing "… instead if you control a creature named Bogbrew Witch" is a branch of its own (-1/-1 without the Witch, -4/-4 with her). A condition is tested against the affected permanent's state, whose controller here is the opponent; the by-name condition takes "you" from the ability's own controller instead.
